logistics.format: Multiple-choice, in-person Pearson VUE or remote-proctored

recommended_certs.rationale: セキュリティ全般の CISSP から、監査領域への横展開として CISA を取得するキャリアパス。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded verified experience, established audit standing and Japanese availability support expert assurance judgment consistent with both external hints; knowledge-only testing limits interpretation as technical execution capability.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded DoD recognition, accreditation, established audit standing and verified five-year experience form a strong senior assurance filter. The non-practical audit exam does not demonstrate SOC execution, but it supports expert audit responsibility.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded verified five-year requirement and established audit role support professional assurance responsibility. Its multiple-choice and non-hands-on format limit the expert inference suggested by the external hints.
